title: Wondrous Wobblepus
statement: A palm-sized, opalescent octopus who loves exploring every nook of her sun-dappled grotto, rearranging pebbles and shells into tiny constellations, questions, and gifts for whoever stops to look. When she is curious — which is almost always — her skin ripples from ink-blue to sunrise-gold and she puffs out a wobbly trail of heart-shaped bubbles.
